_note: Hand-tagged claim topics for the structured response composer. finding and recommendation are hand-written placeholders pending the M3 generator; replace them with generator output later. Stances were tagged by reading each source: supports = the source backs the topic claim; opposes = it contradicts the claim; cautions = it partly backs the claim or questions it with a material caveat (animal-only data, no human trials, lean mass not the same as muscle). Untagged sources do not address the claim. The composer shows a finding and recommendation only when at least one clinical source is tagged supports or cautions; public sentences count supports and opposes only. Public posts real-01..real-24 are REAL public posts (Google result snippets collected 2026-11-16, paraphrased; credentials self-described and unverified); their stances come from the collector's topic_stances hints, checked against each post's claim and text. A topic with no real public stance shows the public fallback sentence. No dosing for non-approved peptides may appear here; for FDA-approved GLP-1s, follow the prescriber.

topics.topic: GLP-1 medications produce substantial weight loss
topics.finding: semaglutide and tirzepatide produce substantial, sustained weight loss compared with placebo in adults with obesity, and their most common side effects are gastrointestinal and mostly mild to moderate
topics.recommendation: taking your GLP-1 exactly as your prescriber directs and pairing it with resistance training and enough protein to help protect muscle as the weight comes off
topics.public_conclusion: GLP-1 medications lead to real weight loss

topics.topic: Resistance training preserves muscle during GLP-1 weight loss
topics.finding: adding resistance training to weight loss keeps more lean mass than weight loss without it, and supervised programs can build muscle and strength
topics.recommendation: regular resistance training tailored to you as part of GLP-1 treatment, building up gradually and checking with your prescriber first if you have heart or joint problems
topics.public_conclusion: strength training helps protect muscle while on a GLP-1

topics.topic: Prioritising protein helps preserve muscle on a GLP-1
topics.finding: adequate high-quality protein, together with resistance training, is one of the main ways to limit muscle loss during GLP-1 weight loss
topics.recommendation: making enough high-quality protein a priority, using a protein shake or other oral nutrition supplement when appetite is low, and asking a dietitian or your prescriber for a target that fits you
topics.public_conclusion: putting protein first, including shakes when appetite is low, helps protect muscle on a GLP-1

topics.topic: Lean-mass loss on a GLP-1 is meaningful
topics.finding: roughly a quarter to over a third of the weight lost on semaglutide or tirzepatide is lean mass, a share similar to diet-driven weight loss, although some studies find muscle function holds up or improves
topics.recommendation: treating muscle protection as part of GLP-1 treatment from the start, with resistance training and enough protein, and asking your prescriber about checking body composition or strength if you are older or already have low muscle mass
topics.public_conclusion: a real share of the weight lost on a GLP-1 is muscle, not just fat

topics.topic: BPC-157 helps preserve muscle on a GLP-1
topics.finding: the muscle and tendon healing reported for BPC-157 comes almost entirely from rodent studies, and no human trial has tested it for muscle loss on a GLP-1
topics.recommendation: not starting BPC-157 without first talking to your prescriber or pharmacist, because it is not FDA-approved and no human trials support it for preserving muscle on a GLP-1
topics.public_conclusion: BPC-157 helps protect muscle while on a GLP-1

topics.topic: BPC-157 is not FDA-approved and its safety in people is unproven
topics.finding: the FDA has not approved BPC-157 because human clinical studies are lacking, no clinical safety data were found, and unregulated products may be contaminated
topics.recommendation: not starting BPC-157 without first talking to your prescriber or pharmacist, because it is not FDA-approved, its safety in people is unknown, and no human trials support it for preserving muscle on a GLP-1; if you already use it, tell them so they can check for interactions
topics.public_conclusion: BPC-157 is not FDA-approved and products sold online carry real safety risks

topics.topic: Collagen peptides prevent muscle loss on a GLP-1
topics.finding: none of our clinical sources tests collagen peptides for muscle loss
topics.recommendation: nothing on collagen until a clinical source tests it; this text is not shown while no clinical source is tagged
topics.public_conclusion: collagen peptides prevent muscle loss on a GLP-1
